page_title: PDF Auditor - Inspect and Analyze PDFs on macOS

sources.entry: PDF Auditor - PDF inspection tool for analyzing metadata, structure, and security risks. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6738956506?pt=127483661&ct=GitHub&mt=8&platform=mac)

summary.name: PDF Auditor
summary.one_liner: A macOS PDF inspection tool that analyzes a file's structure, security settings, embedded JavaScript, metadata, fonts, and hidden content locally without altering the original.
use_cases: audit PDFs for embedded JavaScript and security risks
check metadata and author info before sharing a document
find hidden text or redaction problems
pre-flight review of links, bookmarks, and accessibility tags
extract attachments and images from PDFs
verify digital signatures and form fields
summary.what_it_does: PDF Auditor inspects PDF files on macOS and reports on file properties, XMP metadata, page geometry, encryption and permissions, and digital signatures. It lists embedded JavaScript with syntax highlighting and risk assessment, plus fonts, annotations, form fields, XFA packets, links, and bookmarks. It can detect hidden text, incremental updates, and integrity issues, and it shows the PDF structure tree and accessibility tags. Attachments and images can be extracted, and results can be exported as CSV or JSON.
notable: Processes PDFs locally on the Mac, with no upload
Forensic checks for embedded JavaScript, hidden text, incremental updates and redaction issues
Read-only inspection that does not modify the original file
caveats: Pro features (deep forensic analysis, bulk export, professional review workflows) require $19.99/year or $59.99 lifetime, with a 7-day free trial
Requires macOS 12 Monterey or later on Apple silicon Macs
Not a PDF editor; it only analyzes and does not alter files
